scene.name: The Instantiator Laboratory
scene.description: Six connected rooms around a circulation spine: an experimental laboratory, side machinery, medical ward, access chamber, records and supplies. The three restraint beds must face the Instantiator.
scene.visualDirection: True overhead dark stone and steampunk copper, soot-black iron, tarnished brass, restrained violet and viridian glow. Hand-painted mineral texture, fine mechanical ornament, no perspective, text or grid.

rooms.name: Central laboratory
rooms.purpose: The large Instantiator dominates the chamber; exactly three restraint beds direct their head ends toward its core.

features.description: Large copper Instantiator with a violet containment core and concentric brass coils
Iron restraint bed with leather straps; head/front points toward the Instantiator
Protective brass cage around an oil lamp
Instrument trays, loose wires, gauges and copper hand tools
Small control desks and worn stools, visually subordinate to the experiment

rooms.name: Side machinery room
rooms.purpose: Power conversion and maintenance supporting the experiment.

features.description: Heavy flywheel dynamo with green current indicators
Maintenance benches, tool racks and spare gears

rooms.name: Medical ward
rooms.purpose: Recovery and treatment, distinct from the experiment's three restraint beds.

features.description: Clean medical recovery bed with folded linen and no restraints
Medicine cupboards, wash bowls and treatment stools

rooms.name: Access chamber
rooms.purpose: Controlled entry, protective clothing and visitor inspection.

features.description: Coat pegs, protective aprons, boots and a narrow bench

rooms.name: Research archive
rooms.purpose: Experiment logs, diagrams and specimen records.

features.description: Tall bookshelves, filing cabinets, a writing desk and parchment bundles
Crates, labelled-looking unlettered bottles, copper vessels and storage shelving
